top_signals.title: Peru is losing a battle against illegal gold mining in its rainforests
top_signals.summary: Even when operations to disrupt illegal gold mines go according to plan, it's only a matter of days before miners return, said a federal prosecutor involved in the operations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Apple claims OpenAI is using confidential Apple material and destroying evidence
top_signals.summary: A court brief has been filed in support of Apple's motion for expedited pretrial fact-finding in the lawsuit, which accuses the ChatGPT-maker of stealing trade secrets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
